_comment: Admin defaults for the engineer installer. gatewayUrl: where Claude Code signs in (https origin, or leave empty and use scripts/package-client.sh to stamp it). model: OPTIONAL alias or id from the model catalog (models.json); leave it out and the catalog's "default" decides (so moving everyone to 4.6 is one edit in config/models.json). effortLevel: low|medium|high|xhigh. userSettings: extra user-level Claude Code settings, merged into ~/.claude/settings.json only where the engineer has not set them.
